concepts.gloss_en: "out of order / not in sequence" — the disruption of divine order, associated with conflict (milchama) and the opposition of wills in LM2:82

members.note: representative; appears verbatim in proofs as שֶׁלֹּא כְּסֵדֶר
same phrase כסדר negated; differs only by the proclitic ש- (relative/conjunctive clitic). Same referent 'out of order' in the same Torah's usage

notes: Both are the negated form of כסדר. The only difference is the proclitic ש-, a grammatical clitic that does not change the referent; kept together as 'likely' rather than 'obvious' since it is a morphological (not purely orthographic) difference.
